description: Defines an enum class 'CameraHudKind' for different HUD states and a data class 'CameraHudState' representing the current HUD state with associated properties.

classes.name: CameraHudKind
classes.description: An enumeration representing various HUD states such as Photo, Recording, Success, and Error.

classes.name: CameraHudState
classes.description: A data class encapsulating the HUD state with a token identifier, a kind (of 'CameraHudKind'), and a message string.

methods.name: CameraHudState
methods.description: Constructor for initializing a 'CameraHudState' with a token, kind, and message.
